description: A mid-month enumeration for the 'Mid-month invocation' scenario: the same active/on_hold pair whose episodes were opened on the 1st, plus one enrollment that activated on the 10th and has no episode yet. `month` is the 15th itself — the run's invocation day, not the billing month's first — to exercise that the derived idempotency key and effective_at depend only on the billing month, never the day the job happens to run.
